QuestInfo.name: Scaling the El Nath Mountains
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart sent you a letter. Go to Victoria Island to make sure everything's all right.
QuestInfo.1: According to Neinheart, there have been signs of the Oda Army in the El Nath Mountains of Orbis. Go to Orbis and then go down through the tower to reach El Nath.
QuestInfo.2: You ran into Kanetsugu in Orbis. It's been a while since you last spoke.
